text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tonight is Christmas. With various events 
taking place, it was a bustling night 
across campus, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Hah... Hah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Out on the track, Mejiro Ramonu's soft 
breaths echoed through the air.
choice_data_list: Alright, let's call it a day

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: You're right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Good work.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Something catches my attention. We've been 
training hard all day, and Mejiro Ramonu 
doesn't seem to have any other plans lined 
up.
choice_data_list: Do you have plans after this?
Do you have plans after this?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Is that your roundabout way of asking me 
out?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Nothing of the sort that you are 
imagining.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Just eat and rest. That's all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: See you tomorrow...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After parting ways with Mejiro Ramonu, I 
was sorting through paperwork, but...

text_block_list.name: Restaurant Clerk
text_block_list.text: Welcome! Care for some Christmas cake?!

text_block_list.name: Restaurant Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We've got chicken, fizzy juice, wreath 
salad, and everything else you could want!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Walking a bit further, I saw Christmas 
dishes being sold around town. My interest 
piqued, I stopped to take a look.
choice_data_list:
(What kind of things does Ramonu like, I 
wonder?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Before I knew it, I had picked out and 
bought only things she would like. 
Clutching the heavy bags, I made my way 
back to the academy—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Aimlessly wandering, I found myself 
overlooking the course. There, I saw...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...—Oh, my.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Such a large amount of luggage. Are you 
planning to throw a party, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu's reaction at the end of 
today's training—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: You're right.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I still want to run, but I'll choose to 
rest out of consideration for my body"... 
That's how it was. That's surely why it 
felt unfulfilling.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: You mean to say you saw right through me?
choice_data_list:
For three whole years, I've thought of 
nothing but you.

For three whole years, I've thought of 
nothing but you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I have never once given you a second 
thought.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I know nothing of you, other than as a 
part of the race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
No interest whatsoever. And yet, you still 
give.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: You love me, don't you? Me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her direct words startled me for a moment. 
But unraveling her true intentions... 
looking back on the love she speaks of, 
this is by no means a trap.
choice_data_list: Yeah, just like how you love racing.
Yeah, just as you love racing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? If that were the case, it 
would be far more relentless.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: If you wish to run away, then so be it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Laying everything out in the open would 
take all the fun out of it, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...You are going to have a party, aren't 
you? Why don't you have a seat?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: No.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I shall focus on what I need to think 
about. And you, on yours...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure you won't mind. —If you love me, 
that is."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, quietly gazing out over the track 
together, the Christmas night deepened.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Very well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"You'll just end up thinking about races 
anyway, won't you?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
A passionate way of speaking... I don't 
dislike it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
You shall recreate it for me. With your 
own words.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Beautiful races.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Ah, I have seen it on video, of course.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
The first horse girl from Japan to accept 
an overseas invitation and take on the 
challenge abroad...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Domestic glory, followed by adversity 
overseas... At the end of it all, that 
hard-fought first victory was grasped.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps it was on the final straight. Her 
tenacity was truly formidable, after all."
choice_data_list:
Hang in there, hang in there! Just a 
little more...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Her eyes are glistening with tears.
choice_data_list: It just reminded me of something...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Your circle takes in and overlaps with 
others, doesn't it? Taking all that 
departed love into your heart..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
When you talk about them, even races I 
know well seem to take on a whole new 
shape.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: What else? Go on...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, while nibbling on Christmas-themed 
dishes with Mejiro Ramonu... we talked 
about racing.
